name: Wrong password shows an error and stays on the login screen
title: SC-06-02-04 Wrong password shows an error and stays on the login screen
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

When the manager submits a wrong password
Then the login error banner is shown
And the login screen is still displayed
